profile_text.body:
Softmax is a startup founded in 2025 and headquartered in San Francisco, California. According to its own site, it is an independent research lab whose work is supported by a small group of individuals and organizations. The company describes its focus as multi-agent machine learning at scale, studying how agents learn when and how to share goals, develop specialized roles, and generate collectively intelligent systems. It frames this work under the term organic alignment, which it describes as the process by which individuals learn to form flourishing wholes at ever greater scales.

The site describes a universe of multiplayer games where humans and their coding agents compete, cooperate, and interact. Softmax presents this as a learning, training, and testing environment covering foundation models, harnesses, prompts, skills, and loops, with users able to A/B test Claude against Codex, tune a memory system, or train their own model in the arena. The company says feedback is rapid and verified, and that skills agents earn there, such as cooperation, negotiation, and handling the unpredictable, carry into the real world. It states that everything it does pursues its stated mission of helping humanity navigate the transition to a world with powerful AI through genuine scientific understanding.

The record shows no tracked products, no MCP servers, and no lawsuits involving the company. Its law exposure is recorded in California, with a count of 281.
